summary.name: Grok-1
summary.one_liner: Grok-1 is xAI's open-weights large language model (314B parameters), with weights hosted on Hugging Face under xai-org/grok-1.
use_cases: Downloading Grok-1 weights for local experimentation
Running a large open-weights language model on multi-GPU hardware
summary.what_it_does: The page hosts the weights of the Grok-1 open-weights language model from xAI. It provides instructions to download the int8 checkpoint (ckpt-0) using huggingface-cli into a local checkpoints directory. The code itself lives in a separate GitHub repository, and the setup runs via pip install of requirements and python run.py. The model is described as 314B parameters, and the page notes that a multi-GPU machine is needed to run the example code. The page does not include inference code snippets for the Hugging Face libraries.
notable: Code lives in a separate GitHub repository
Requires a multi-GPU machine to run example code
caveats: Requires a multi-GPU machine due to the 314B parameter size
No Hugging Face library code snippets are available yet
